blockers.detail: No public repository released by authors.
No adapter or model weights available for verification.
137,090 QA pairs are proprietary to authors' lab.
Test subset IDs and size N used in Table 1 are unstated.
Paper training requires 8 x A100 (80GB); local has 1 x T4 GPU.
Paper evaluated 3B, 7B, 13B; local research backbone is 0.5B.
Original Ticktack uses embedding addition h + TE(x) + TE(y) and standard LoRA; partner uses Periodic Dual-Cycle MaT-LoRA B F(theta,z) A.
Paper prompt strings and decoding parameters not published.
